adventures.title: The Forgotten Crypt
adventures.intro: Deep in the mountains, you stumble upon an ancient crypt...

entrance.description: You find a locked door with two paths ahead.

choices.left: You enter a narrow corridor filled with skeletal remains.
choices.right: You enter a dimly lit chamber with an altar.

skeletal_corridor.description: The skeletal remains animate and attack!

altar_chamber.description: The altar glows. A shadowy figure demands an offering.

gold.result: The shadow whispers a blessing upon you.

refuse.result: The shadow curses you and vanishes.

treasure_room.description: You find a chest overflowing with gold and jewels.
treasure_room.ending: You leave the crypt victorious, your pockets heavy with treasure.

trap_room.description: The floor collapses beneath you! You barely survive.
trap_room.ending: You crawl out of the crypt, battered but alive.

adventures.title: The Enchanted Garden
adventures.intro: A hidden path leads you to a vibrant garden humming with magical energy...

entrance.description: A gnarled tree whispers riddles to those who enter.

answer correctly.result: The tree smiles and reveals a hidden path.

flower_meadow.description: A beautiful meadow hums with enchanted flowers.

pick flowers.result: The flowers release a soothing scent, healing your wounds.

move quietly.result: You slip past unseen, reaching the heart of the garden.

thorny_path.description: The vines lash out, tearing at your armor.

sacred_tree.description: The heart of the garden awaits — a tree glowing with power.

drink the sap.result: The sap restores your strength and grants you visions of the future.
drink the sap.ending: You leave the garden feeling stronger and wiser.

cut the tree.result: The tree screams, cursing you as its power fades.
cut the tree.ending: You escape the dying garden, but a shadow follows you.

adventures.title: The Bandit's Hideout
adventures.intro: Following a trail of smoke, you discover a bandit camp in the hills.

entrance.description: You spot sentries patrolling the perimeter.

sneak in.result: You slip past the guards and enter the camp.

attack directly.result: You charge in and face the guards head-on!

bribe.result: The leader laughs but accepts your gold.
bribe.ending: You leave safely but lighter in coin.

challenge.result: The leader accepts your challenge to combat!

loot_room.description: You discover a hidden stash of gold and valuables!
